agent.note: Tool allowlist as comma string or YAML list; omitted inherits all. Agent(a, b) limits spawnable types for a main agent.
Tools removed from the inherited or listed pool; applied before tools. mcp__<server> removes a whole server.
Alias sonnet, opus, haiku, fable, a full model ID, or inherit; omitted falls through the subagent model order.
Permission mode for the subagent (manual aliases default); omitted inherits; ignored for plugin agents.
Maximum agentic turns before the subagent stops and returns output marked partial.
Gives the agent a persistent memory directory at that scope, loading its MEMORY.md at start.
Keeps this subagent in the background even when Claude asks to run it in the foreground.
Launches the subagent without user, project and local CLAUDE.md files; ignored when run as main agent.
Effort level while this subagent is active; overrides the session level but not CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL.
Runs the subagent in a temporary git worktree, removed automatically if it makes no changes.
Display color for the subagent in the task list and transcript.
First user turn auto-submitted when this agent runs as the main session agent; commands and skills expand.
Map of experimental options; only cacheTtl is read, and only from agent files.
Prompt cache lifetime for this subagent's requests; 1h is ignored while on usage credits.

skill.note: Extra trigger context appended to description; both share a 1,536-character listing cap.
Hint shown in autocomplete for expected arguments, such as [issue-number].
Named positional arguments for $name substitution, as a space-separated string or YAML list.
Stops Claude from loading the skill on its own; it runs only via /name and cannot be preloaded.
Set false to hide the skill from the / menu so only Claude can invoke it.
Tools usable without a permission prompt during the invoking turn; space/comma string or YAML list.
Tools removed from Claude's pool while the skill is active; cleared at the next user message.
Model for the rest of the turn (same values as /model, or inherit); with context: fork, the fork's model.
Effort level while the skill is active, overriding the session effort.
Set to fork to run the skill in its own forked subagent context.
Subagent type that runs the skill when context: fork is set.
With context: fork only; false waits for the fork's result in the invoking turn.
Hooks registered when the skill is invoked and kept for the rest of the session; handlers may set once.
Globs limiting auto-activation to matching files; comma string or YAML list. Not accepted in command files.
Shell used for !`command` and ```! injection blocks in this skill.
Free-form map for your own tooling; Claude Code ignores it and drops a non-map value.
Licence covering the skill (Agent Skills spec); accepted but not acted on.
Environment requirements, up to 500 chars (Agent Skills spec); accepted but not acted on.

events.name: SessionStart
events.note: Session begins or resumes. Matcher: startup, resume, clear, compact, fork.

events.name: Setup
events.note: Launch with --init-only, or -p with --init or --maintenance. Matcher: init, maintenance.

events.name: UserPromptSubmit
events.note: A prompt is submitted, before Claude processes it; can block. No matcher.

events.name: UserPromptExpansion
events.note: A typed command expands into a prompt; can block. Matcher: command or skill name.

events.name: MessageDisplay
events.note: While assistant message text is displayed. No matcher.

events.name: PreToolUse
events.note: Before a tool call executes; can block or rewrite input. Matcher: tool name.

events.name: PermissionRequest
events.note: A tool call needs a permission decision. Matcher: tool name.

events.name: PermissionDenied
events.note: Auto mode denies a tool call; may return retry: true. Matcher: tool name.

events.name: PostToolUse
events.note: After a tool call succeeds. Matcher: tool name.

events.name: PostToolUseFailure
events.note: After a tool call fails. Matcher: tool name.

events.name: PostToolBatch
events.note: A batch of parallel tool calls resolves, before the next model call. No matcher.

events.name: Notification
events.note: Claude Code sends a notification. Matcher: type, e.g. permission_prompt, idle_prompt, auth_success.

events.name: SubagentStart
events.note: A subagent is spawned. Matcher: agent type (Explore, Plan, custom or plugin:name).

events.name: SubagentStop
events.note: A subagent finishes. Matcher: agent type.

events.name: TaskCreated
events.note: A task is being created via TaskCreate. No matcher.

events.name: TaskCompleted
events.note: A task is being marked completed. No matcher.

events.name: Stop
events.note: Claude finishes responding; can force it to continue. No matcher.

events.name: StopFailure
events.note: The turn ends on an API error. Matcher: error type, e.g. rate_limit, overloaded, server_error.

events.name: TeammateIdle
events.note: An agent team teammate is about to go idle. No matcher.

events.name: InstructionsLoaded
events.note: A CLAUDE.md or rules file loads. Matcher: session_start, nested_traversal, path_glob_match, include, compact.

events.name: ConfigChange
events.note: A config file changes mid-session. Matcher: user_settings, project_settings, local_settings, policy_settings, skills.

events.name: CwdChanged
events.note: The working directory changes, e.g. after cd. No matcher.

events.name: DirectoryAdded
events.note: A directory is added mid-session. Matcher: slash_command, register_repo_root.

events.name: FileChanged
events.note: A watched file changes on disk. Matcher: literal filenames to watch, | separated.

events.name: WorktreeCreate
events.note: A worktree is created (--worktree, isolation, background session); replaces git. No matcher.

events.name: WorktreeRemove
events.note: A worktree that a WorktreeCreate hook made is being removed. No matcher.

events.name: PreCompact
events.note: Before context compaction. Matcher: manual, auto.

events.name: PostCompact
events.note: After context compaction completes. Matcher: manual, auto.

events.name: PreModelSwitch
events.note: Before a requested model switch applies; can block. Matcher: canonical target model name.

events.name: PostModelSwitch
events.note: After the session model changes, including automatic changes. Matcher: canonical model name.

events.name: Elicitation
events.note: An MCP server requests user input during a tool call. Matcher: MCP server name.

events.name: ElicitationResult
events.note: A user answers an MCP elicitation, before it is sent back. Matcher: MCP server name.

events.name: SessionEnd
events.note: The session terminates. Matcher: clear, resume, logout, prompt_input_exit, other.

command.note: Shell command to run; with args, the executable spawned directly with no shell.
Argument vector; when present the hook runs in exec form, each element one argument, no shell.
Runs in the background without blocking; results arrive next turn and timeout is not enforced.
Runs in the background and wakes Claude with its output when it exits with code 2.
Shell for shell form; defaults to powershell on Windows without Git Bash. Ignored when args is set.
One permission rule, e.g. Bash(git *); tool events only, elsewhere the hook never runs.
Seconds before cancelling; default 600, lowered to 30 on prompt/model-switch events and 10 on MessageDisplay.
Custom spinner message shown while the hook runs.
Removes the hook after its first successful run; honoured only in skill frontmatter.

http.note: Endpoint that receives the POST; must match allowedHttpHookUrls when that setting exists.
Extra request headers; values may interpolate $VAR or ${VAR} listed in allowedEnvVars.
Environment variable names allowed in header values; unlisted references become empty.
One permission rule, e.g. Bash(git *); tool events only, elsewhere the hook never runs.
Seconds before cancelling; default 600, lowered to 30 on prompt/model-switch events and 10 on MessageDisplay.
Custom spinner message shown while the hook runs.
Removes the hook after its first successful run; honoured only in skill frontmatter.

mcp_tool.note: Configured MCP server name; plugin servers use plugin:<plugin>:<server>.
Name of the tool to call on that server.
Tool arguments; string values support ${path} substitution from the hook input JSON.
One permission rule, e.g. Bash(git *); tool events only, elsewhere the hook never runs.
Seconds before cancelling; default 600, lowered to 30 on prompt/model-switch events and 10 on MessageDisplay.
Custom spinner message shown while the hook runs.
Removes the hook after its first successful run; honoured only in skill frontmatter.

prompt.note: Prompt text; $ARGUMENTS is replaced by the hook input JSON, or the JSON is appended if absent.
Model for the evaluation; defaults to the background-functionality model.
On ok: false, feeds the reason back to Claude and continues instead of ending the turn.
One permission rule, e.g. Bash(git *); tool events only, elsewhere the hook never runs.
Custom spinner message shown while the hook runs.
Removes the hook after its first successful run; honoured only in skill frontmatter.

agent.note: Task for the verifier; $ARGUMENTS is replaced by the hook input JSON.
Model for the verifier; defaults to the background-functionality model.
One permission rule, e.g. Bash(git *); tool events only, elsewhere the hook never runs.
Seconds before cancelling the verifier.
Custom spinner message shown while the hook runs.
Removes the hook after its first successful run; honoured only in skill frontmatter.

stdio.note: Transport; an entry with no type is read as stdio.

http.note: Streamable HTTP transport; streamable-http is an alias of http.

sse.note: Deprecated Server-Sent Events transport; prefer http.

ws.note: WebSocket transport; configurable only by JSON (.mcp.json or claude mcp add-json).

https support link for the directory listing; ignored by Claude Code.
https privacy policy link for the directory listing; ignored by Claude Code.
https terms of service link for the directory listing; ignored by Claude Code.
Whether the plugin starts enabled when enabledPlugins does not set it.
Plugins that must be enabled: "name", "name@marketplace" or {name, marketplace, version}.

Path to a .d.ts declaring a mod's $.state values and $ nouns.

Container for themes, monitors and evals, whose shape may still change.
